lede: Still hunting for physical media shops in Dhaka? Part 2 of our video guide picks up where Part 1 left off.
body:
Still looking for **physical media shops in Dhaka**? Part 2 of our video guide, posted on 16 September 2026, picks up where [Part 1](post:physical-media-shops-dhaka-part-1) left off, with the same promise up front: "Looking for physical media shops in Dhaka? We got you!"

## What this guide to physical media shops in Dhaka covers

The series is for anyone who'd rather hold their music than stream it. The hashtags set the mood: #analogrevival, #cassetteculture, #hiddengemsdhaka, #retrovibes, #physicalmedia and #DhakaDiaries. The shops themselves are shown in the video on Instagram, and this page doesn't list them, so watch the original post for names and locations.

## Why physical media still matters in Dhaka

Streaming made music easier to reach and easier to forget. A tape or a record is different. You choose it, carry it home and play it from start to finish. Shops that still stock these formats double as meeting points for collectors, and they keep older Bangladeshi releases in circulation when they might otherwise disappear.

For the bigger story, read about [Dhaka's vinyl and cassette revival](post:dhaka-vinyl-cassette-revival). If your collecting runs to comics as well, see our tribute to [Jamil's Comics](post:jamils-comics-bangladesh-comic-book-culture). Everything analog lives on our [pop culture hub](topic:pop-culture), and more is on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdWVvOImiI5/)
